rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone's naivety or lack of sophistication.

example.english: His naivety made him easy to fool.
example.traditional: 佢嘅天真令佢好容易畀人呃。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 tin1 zan1 ling6 keoi5 hou2 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 ngaak1

rows.note: Use this when the naivety is being criticized as childish or immature.

example.english: Your naivety really leaves me speechless.
example.traditional: 你嘅幼稚真係令我無言。
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 jau3 zi6 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 mou4 jin4

rows.note: Use this for a light, colloquial kind of naivety with a slightly silly or endearing quality.

example.english: Your naivety is quite endearing sometimes.
example.traditional: 你有時嗰份傻氣幾得意。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 si4 go2 fan6 so4 hei3 gei2 dak1 ji3
